Family-owned since 2017

Mountain Weather: a family-owned HVAC company in Kearny, NJ

Mountain Weather was built the way good HVAC work gets done — step by step, with patience and the right training. This is how a newcomer to the United States became the owner of a heating and cooling company that has served more than 2,000 customers.

Mountain Weather is a family-owned heating and cooling company founded on July 19, 2017 and based in Kearny, New Jersey, focused on emergency HVAC service and HVAC system replacement.

The journey

Built step by step, since 2015

No shortcuts and no big launch — just training, persistence and a lot of hard work.

  1. 2015

    A new beginning

    Our founder arrived in the United States in 2015 with no experience in the local market and no connections in the industry. What he did have was determination. Rather than trying a little of everything, he decided to focus on one trade and learn it properly.

  2. The groundwork

    Learning the trade the right way

    He enrolled in technical courses, studied heating and cooling systems, and worked through the requirements to earn his licenses and secure insurance. It wasn’t the fastest path, but it was the right one — and it’s the foundation of everything Mountain Weather does today.

  3. July 19, 2017

    Mountain Weather is founded

    With encouragement from a friend who worked as an accountant, he made it official: Mountain Weather opened on July 19, 2017. It has been a family business from day one.

  4. The early years

    Two jobs, one goal

    In the early years, he balanced his own company with work for other HVAC businesses — gaining experience on a wide range of jobs while steadily building a base of customers of his own.

  5. The leap

    Going all-in on Mountain Weather

    Then came the decision that took real courage: leaving the security of working for others to dedicate himself entirely to Mountain Weather. He took the risk to gain his independence — and to give every customer his full attention.

  6. Today

    More than 2,000 customers served

    Mountain Weather has now served more than 2,000 customers. The company is still family-owned, still based in Kearny, and still guided by a simple idea: learn it right, then do it right.

What we stand for

The values behind every service call

  • Learn it right

    The company was built on training, licensing and insurance — not shortcuts. That standard hasn’t changed.

  • Do it right

    Careful, thorough work and honest recommendations — whether the answer is a repair or a replacement.

  • Treat people like neighbors

    Clear communication, respect for your home and a direct line to the people doing the work.

  • Own the result

    As a family-owned business, our name is on every job. That’s a responsibility we take personally.

How we can help

Two services, one standard

Today, Mountain Weather focuses on the moments when heating and cooling matter most. When a system fails, our emergency heating and cooling service starts with a text or a call. When equipment is reaching the end of its life, our system replacement guide explains the signs, the benefits and the process.

We’re based in Kearny — see where we work, or reach out to ask about your address.
